sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb]Sowing in the morning, sowing seeds of [Gm]kindness,
[Bb]Sowing in the noontide and the [F]dewy eve,
[Bb/F]Waiting for the harvest and the time of [Gm]reaping –

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Bb/F]Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves,
[Bb/F]Bringing in the sheaves, bringing in the sheaves,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb]Sowing in the sunshine, sowing in the [Gm]shadows,
[Bb/F]By and by the harvest and the labor [Gm]ended -

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb]Going forth with weeping, sowing for the Master,
[Bb]Tho the loss sustained our spirit often [F]grieves;
[Bb/F]When our weeping's over He will bid us [Gm]welcome -
